title: Chapter 229 Goblins All Over The War Zone
content:
Chapter 229 Goblins All Over The War Zone

Wu Qing and the Zerg army went through a teleportation, but it was not over yet. If they wanted to go to the battlefield, they needed to go through another teleportation to reach the final destination.

Gong Yi led Wu Qing and the Zerg army to move to another square next door, where there was a space transmission channel.

The public battlefield in the Southern Theater is very large, divided into many areas, and the area of each area is also very large. The only way to travel between areas is through space transmission channels. If you really have to run, you may not be able to reach the destination even if you run to death.

Gong Yi led Wu Qing and the Zerg army through another teleportation, and finally arrived at the destination arranged by the goblins for the Zerg.

"This is the 108th area of the public battlefield in the Southern Theater. It is a high-quality area selected by our tribe after comprehensive consideration!"

Gong Yi introduced to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing looked around and saw that on the same huge square, a space was cleared by the tall goblin guards, and there were many people of other races watching around.

Continue to observe from a distance, you can see that this is a super giant city!

The transmission capacity of the space transmission channel is very large. Thousands or tens of thousands of troops were transmitted at a time, and the entire Zerg army was quickly transmitted, including the huge Zerg transport host.

The crowd of onlookers who had been talking about Wu Qing and the Zerg's identity had caused a huge sensation when they saw the Zerg flying dragons appear in large numbers.

"Look! Here comes another flying army!"

"These flying army are not good guys! Those birdmen claim to be the overlords of the sky and always suppress the flying army of other races. I hope this new strong man can teach them a lesson!"

"The race that the goblins made such a big noise to welcome must be not simple!"

"It's getting more and more lively! I just hope they defeat the enemy first, and then compete, and don't fight among themselves first!"

"This group of strong men came to our 108th District as their first stop. It seems that our 108th District is about to turn around!"

"We are the least affected by those tribes here. It is a wise choice for them to come here as their first stop!"

"Who are they! I want to see what they can do!"

"..."

One hundred four-star Zerg hosts and ten huge transport hosts floated in the air, quickly collecting information around them. Of course, the discussions of the onlookers could not escape their perception.

With the four-star strength of the Zerg hosts and their full stealth talent, few people would notice their existence.

They are obviously the most conspicuous existence, but few people pay attention to them. Instead, the Zerg flying dragons attracted the most attention as soon as they appeared.

"Lord, this is the main city of the 108th District. The main city has strong defenses. As long as it is not broken by the enemy, it is a safe zone!"

"Outside the main city is the war zone! There are no rules on the battlefield here, and you can move freely. The enemy is likely to lurk outside the main city!"

"The lord's protection area outside the main city is very large. The army does not need to withdraw to the main city at night, and the enemy's army can also operate in these areas for a long time!"

"So, night can also be a time for fighting, so you must pay attention!"

"Outside the main city, there are many other cities. These cities have no space transmission channels. If you want to reach them, you can only rely on other means!"

"The two sides can attack and occupy the cities outside the main city. After a long period of fighting, the situation is very complicated!"

"The garrison barracks prepared by our tribe for the lord in the main city are near this space transmission channel, not far from the nearest city gate, very convenient!"

"In addition, Elder Gong Rui also specifically mentioned that the lord can select a batch of supplies and equipment from our tribe's chamber of commerce. All kinds of weapons and equipment newly developed by our tribe can be selected!"

"Here is the list, please take a look, lord!"

"This is some intelligence information about the public battlefield in the southern theater, and some precautions. It is a gift from Elder Gong Rui to you!"

Gong Yi briefly introduced the basic situation here, and handed Wu Qing two books, one is the material list of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, and the other is the intelligence information and precautions prepared by the goblin elder Gong Rui.

Wu Qing reached out to take the book recording intelligence information and precautions, and he did not take the material list of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

"Thank you for the gift from Elder Gong Rui!"

"The logistical supply of the Zerg army is somewhat special, so we don't need the supplies. If possible, I hope to exchange all these supplies for luck beads!"

What Wu Qing needs now is the luck beads, and other things are of little significance to the Zerg.

Gong Yi has the authorization of the goblin elder Gong Rui, and he agreed to Wu Qing's reasonable request without any hesitation: "No problem! I'll have someone convert it and send the luck beads to the barracks later!"

Wu Qing was very satisfied with the result: "Okay! Then let's go to the barracks first!"

With the goblin guards leading the way, the Zerg army followed the extremely spacious avenue and came to the Zerg's future station here, an independent large military camp that can accommodate millions of troops to live and train.

As Gong Yi said, this military camp has a good location, good environment, and good facilities. It is a very good station.

It's a pity that the Zerg don't need to enjoy it. Such a good place is just a place to rest and recover, which is no different from the wilderness.

However, Wu Qing was still very satisfied. These things were symbols of identity and status. The Zerg came so high-profile and occupied such a good piece of land in the main city, so the popularity rose immediately.

Wu Qing had clearly felt that the speed of the system's gas resources increased faster.

Wu Qing came to the gate of the military camp, rode in to take a look, declared his sovereignty, and came out. The Zerg army stayed on the avenue and did not enter the military camp.

Although this is the main city of the war zone, normal life is still needed. There are many things that ordinary cities have.

The main city needs to provide logistics and security for the various ethnic armies in this area, so it has a large population.

The Zerg army occupied the avenue, attracting a large number of onlookers, and the Zerg host was also quickly collecting various information about the city.

Not long after, a team of elite goblin guards arrived quickly and brought a large number of gas luck beads.

"Lord, don't you want to go in and rest?"

Gong Yi asked Wu Qing.

"No need, we just came from the territory, we are in good condition, and now we have to go out of the city to fight!"

"Put the things here, we will use them soon!"

Wu Qing responded.

"Okay, then I wish the Lord a victory!"

Gong Yi said nothing more, and asked the goblin guards to put the boxes of luck beads at the door of the military camp.

He sent Wu Qing and the Zerg army to the military camp. Even if the mission was completed, how the Zerg would fight in the future was the Zerg's own business and had nothing to do with him.

The goblins would provide some help to the Zerg, but they would not help the Zerg to fight. They also wanted to see how strong the Zerg was.

A Zerg transport host flew over and moved all the luck beads into the loading space.

Wu Qing asked the queen to leave a small amount of luck beads for backup, and the rest were converted into system gas resources.

Without further delay, Wu Qing said goodbye to Gong Yi, rode on his warhorse, and led his personal guards to gallop towards the city gate that could already be seen.

Behind him, there was a mighty army of more than 500,000 Zerg.

But from the perspective of a Zerg host flying at the highest point, this army of more than 500,000 Zerg was nothing in the huge main city.

In this main city, there were many military camps that were much larger than the current station of the Zerg army, and the garrisons in the city were countless.

There were many space transmission channels wherever you looked.

This public battlefield in the southern theater was so huge and complicated that the Zerg rushed in like this, and it was difficult to sort out the myriad of things for a while.

Wu Qing didn't want to spend too much time paying attention to other things for the time being. What he wanted now was to lead the Zerg to fight. For other things, let the Queen collect information first, and show it to him when she figured it out.

Looking at the problem from a higher level is always much simpler.

The most important thing now is to let the Zerg join the war as soon as possible, kill the enemy to earn resources, and show the Zerg style on this public race stage.

Wu Qing led the Zerg army out of the city, and the soldiers guarding the city did not stop them. The Zerg army successfully arrived outside the main city, on the real battlefield.

At this time, the Queen of Zerg had analyzed the intelligence given by Gong Rui through the Zerg host, summarized it, and reported it to Wu Qing. Wu Qing took a look and felt a little relieved.

Outside the main city, all you can see is a plain, but you can also see mountains and hills in the distance, and the terrain is relatively complex.

One hundred four-star Zerg hosts took off, bringing a large area under surveillance.

There were many armies of other races coming and going below. These armies had a large scale of tens of thousands of troops, and a small number of only dozens of troops.

Many of these armies were still fighting with the goblins of the evil god camp they encountered. These goblins were an alien race that looked very similar to goblins, and were often called the alien goblin race.

Most of them were slave races of the big clans in the evil god camp, and their beliefs followed the main clan. They were short in stature and average in combat power, but their numbers were very, very large, and their reproduction speed was also very fast.

These goblins are slave armies sent by the alien race. There are so many of them that they are almost all over the war zone.

The intelligence provided by Gong Rui describes the number of these goblins as "countless". The Queen's analysis result is that the number of goblins must be at least more than 10 billion to achieve such an effect.

These goblins are not strong in other abilities, but their ability to escape is absolutely first-class. They travel in groups. When they encounter a small army, they will besiege it. When they encounter a large army, they will hide. When they encounter a tough guy who can't be defeated, they will escape. They are very good at this.

They are all over the war zone, wandering around the cities of the local camp for a long time, and entering the protection range of the lords of the city at night.

They are also good at digging holes, camouflage and reporting for credit. For the local camp, they are very disgusting and difficult guys, but for the evil god camp, this is a very good racial soldier to get information and harass the enemy.
